title: Take-Two Aims to Take Down GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek with Microsoft and Discord Subpoenas
description: GTA 6 publisher Take-Two is taking aggressive legal action, subpoenaing Microsoft and Discord to track down the infamous leaker known as Cyberleek.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two Cracks Down on GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek with Help from Microsoft and Discord

As one of the most anticipated entertainment releases in history, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is a constant target for data miners, leakers, and curious fans alike. However, publisher Take-Two Interactive is making it abundantly clear that unauthorized leaks will be met with severe consequences. According to recent reports from gaming outlet Push Square, the company is actively hunting down the person or group behind the moniker "Cyberleek."

### Targeting "Cyberleek" Through Legal Channels

In its relentless pursuit to bring the offending party to justice, Take-Two has officially issued subpoenas to both Microsoft and Discord. The publisher is requesting the active participation and cooperation of these major tech and communication platforms as part of a sweeping legal crackdown designed to unmask the individual(s) operating under the Cyberleek alias.

Because modern game development leaks frequently circulate through messaging apps, cloud services, and community servers, targeting infrastructure providers like Microsoft and Discord represents a critical step for legal teams attempting to trace digital footprints. Take-Two's aggressive strategy underscores how seriously the publisher takes the protection of its intellectual property and unreleased assets.

### The Ongoing Battle for Game Security

Leaks have long been an unfortunate reality for AAA game development, but the sheer scale and visibility of GTA 6 elevate the stakes significantly. Unsanctioned leaks not only disrupt planned marketing schedules and developer workflows but also risk spoiling the surprises that Rockstar Games carefully curates for the eventual release. While the gaming community eagerly waits for official updates directly from the studio, Take-Two's latest legal maneuvers send an unmistakable warning to anyone attempting to distribute confidential material.

As this legal battle unfolds, all eyes will be on how Microsoft and Discord respond to the subpoenas and whether Take-Two can successfully identify and penalize those responsible for the Cyberleek breach.

## Editor's Take

Take-Two's aggressive pursuit of Cyberleek sends a powerful message to the community: leaking high-profile game assets carries serious legal repercussions. Protecting the integrity of GTA 6 is paramount for Rockstar, and utilizing subpoenas against major tech platforms shows that publishers will use every tool available to stop leaks at the source.
